# `state/witness/Witness.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/witness/Witness.js`

state/witness/Witness.js — debug proof for every projection / commit.  Replaces "1 happened, 2 happened, 3 happened" timelines with: these facts existed · these rules fired · these branches were possible · this projection was shown · this commit was chosen.

### `makeReceipt(r = {})`

Build a full CSE witness receipt for a transaction commit decision (spec §7). The receipt proves WHAT was checked and WHAT the engine decided — it does not claim the input observations were objectively true. Every committed transition has exactly one receipt (safety invariant, spec §19).

**Parameters:**

- `r` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `r.decision` *('committed'|'rejected')* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `r.transactionID` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[r.authority]` *(string)* — authority that decided
- `[r.preStateRoot]` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[r.postStateRoot]` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[r.consumed]` *(string[])* — USO ids consumed
- `[r.created]` *(string[])* — USO ids created
- `[r.invariantsChecked]` *(string[])* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[r.policyVersion]` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[r.validatorVersion]` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[r.causalParents]` *(string[])* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[r.externalEffectsPending]` *(string[])* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[r.rejection]` *(string)* — reason when decision === 'rejected'
- `[r.violations]` *(Array)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[r.signature]` *(string|null)* — authority signature over the receipt id
